content.title: Summer Camps | Loudoun County, VA
content.text: PRCS Summer CampsSummer fun starts with PRCS! We offer a variety of full-day, half-day, and special interest camps for ages 3-18. Our Adaptive Rec Camp is amazing at providing opportunities for all abilities. PRCS offers camps to help children discover their interests in outdoor adventure, sports, art, science, nature, engineering, dance, music, theater, and more! PRCS campers will have fun in a safe and supportive environment, learn, explore, make new friends, and have the "best summer ever"! Our camps are held at centers, parks, and schools throughout the county.Our 2026 Summer Camp Guide is available here. Printed copies will be available at PRCS center and park offices, county libraries and the PRCS Administration Office starting the week of February 16.2026 Registration Dates & DetailsEarly Registration for families who participated in any of our 2025 Summer Camps and All CARES Families is Tuesday, March 3 at 8:30 a.m through Friday, March 6 at 5:00 p.m.Open Registration starts Tuesday, March 10 at 8:30 a.m.PRCS Summer Camp Registration FAQsOnline registration closes 21 days before the camp week start date (includes Daze/Fest).New Automated WaitlistStarting with Summer Camps in 2026, PRCS will implement an automated waitlist system through PRCS Connect to streamline our waitlist for some programs.* If an opening becomes available in a PRCS waitlisted program, the first individual on the waitlist will receive an email notification from loudounctyprcs@rectrac.com regarding their enrollment offer to register. You will need to log on to your PRCS Connect account to accept or reject enrollment. If the enrollment offer is not accepted or rejected within 36 hours of receiving the email, it will automatically be considered a rejection, and the individual will be removed from the waitlist, and the next eligible person on the waitlist will be contacted. For more information about the new automated waitlist system, visit our Automated Waitlist Frequently Asked Questions page. *The PRCS automated waitlist notifications supports all programs except CASA, YAS, preschool, child care, senior trips, and adaptive recreation camps.How to RegisterOnline: PRCS Connect is PRCS’s online registration system. Before your camp registration date, new households should create an account or existing households should check if they can login. Visit loudoun.gov/prcsconnect or contact PRCS if you need help: 703-777-0343 or email PRCS.In Person: You can register in person at PRCS sites or visit PRCS Main Office at 742 Miller Drive, Leesburg, VA 20175
